title: Final Intensity Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for intensity I as a function of theta.

title: Resolving Power Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for resolving power Δλ/λ in terms of m and N.

title: Phase Difference Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the phase difference between rays from adjacent slits as φ = kd sin θ.

title: Use of Rayleigh Criterion
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the Rayleigh criterion correctly to establish the relationship between wavelengths.

title: Mathematical Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency in units and dimensions throughout the derivation.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the phase difference or intensity equations.

title: Neglecting Diffraction Effects
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must acknowledge the assumption of neglecting diffraction due to finite slit width.
